note: Which vector model is drawn for each type of the park map. model: a name known to Models::byName, drawn by models/<model>.cpp. semi_model: the model for half of a semi-detached block (a house with semi_with in data/houses.json). size: 'model' -> the model decides its size from the outline of the house (Model::footprint); 'outline' -> the outline is used as it is. To show a type with another model, change it here.
